backend/main.mo: Defines asset, portfolio, and validation types, allowlists, and functions for fetching market data with access control and caching.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records describing FIAT VPS1 integration requirements and associated frontend files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend files including components, hooks, utilities, and pages.
Explains a deployment failure caused by a missing backend method required by the frontend actor initialization.
frontend/docs/rebuild-checklist.md: Provides a checklist for performing frontend rebuilds after backend interface or method changes.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, including light/dark theme CSS variables for UI colors.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, authentication gating, theming, and global layout for the React application.
frontend/src/components/assets/AssetSear: Asset search UI that integrates FIAT VPS1 fetching with loading, error, fallback behavior, and result selection.
frontend/src/components/assets/MarketTyp: Dropdown component for selecting a market type with labeled options.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication guard that shows login or profile setup before rendering protected content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginPrompt: Displays the public landing/login page and triggers Internet Identity login with a feature overview.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Empty file placeholder for a dashboard hero component.
Provides the main app layout with header, navigation, theme toggle, user info, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/AddHol: Form for adding a holding with quantity, price, date, and validation, submitting via useAddHolding.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Holdin: Renders a table showing asset holdings with type badges, quantities, and purchase prices.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog prompting the user to set their name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/ThemeToggl: Dropdown button allowing users to switch between light, dark, and system themes.
frontend/src/data/assetCatalog.ts: Static catalog of crypto, stock, commodity, and fiat assets for search and selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddHolding.ts: Mutation hook for adding a holding, currently mocked, and invalidates portfolio queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAssetSearch.ts: Filters assets client‑side using a search term, with optional catalog override by market type.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to fetch and save the current user's profile via react-query and actor calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useFiatVPS1.ts: Implements hooks for fetching, validating, and parsing FIAT VPS1 data with caching and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity context and provider managing login, identity loading, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortfolio.ts: Defines a portfolio query hook returning a temporary empty portfolio until backend support is added.
frontend/src/hooks/usePriceRefreshPlaceh: Placeholder hook that logs periodic refresh events for future price‑update integration.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AddAssetPage.tsx: UI flow for selecting an asset by market type and adding a holding to the portfolio.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the user's portfolio with loading states, empty‑state UI, and a link to add new assets.
frontend/src/pages/FiatTestPage.tsx: Test page for triggering VPS1 FIAT data fetches and displaying validation results.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines frontend types for market types, assets, holdings, and portfolios.
frontend/src/utils/assetSearch.ts: Implements simple case‑insensitive asset search by ticker or name.
frontend/src/utils/fiatFxRatesParser.ts: Parses an fx_rates JSON payload into fiat Asset objects with defensive validation and error reporting. Iterates rate entries to build assets and returns errors when structure is invalid or empty.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing) and persist them in sessionStorage. Includes utilities to store, retrieve, and clear parameters with fallback logic.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, extended theme tokens, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and plugin setup. Defines fonts, radii, shadows, keyframes, and content paths.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, versioning, and a structured list of implemented features with IDs, descriptions, and requirement links. Serves as a snapshot of the app’s current functional state.
